name: mcp-cross
stderr:
[mcp-cross] Version 1.1.0 starting...
Usage: mcp-cross [options] [--] <server-command> [args...]
       mcp-cross --http <url> [options]

Modes:
  Process bridge    Bridge stdio to a child process (default)
  HTTP proxy        Bridge stdio to an HTTP MCP server (--http)

Options:
  --wsl                Bridge to WSL environment (Windows only)
  --distro <name>      Target specific WSL distribution
  --shell <shell>      Shell to use in WSL (default: bash)
  --diagnose           Run diagnostics to check WSL environment
  --http <url>         HTTP proxy mode: target HTTP MCP endpoint URL
  --header <header>    Add custom header (format: "Name: Value")
                       Can be specified multiple times
                       Environment variables ($VAR) are expanded
  --env KEY=VALUE      Inject environment variable for the launched server (repeatable)
  --timeout <ms>       HTTP request timeout (default: 60000)
  --debug              Enable debug logging
  --                   Delimiter separating options from server command

Examples:
  # Direct process bridge
  mcp-cross node server.js
  mcp-cross --wsl node /home/user/server.js

  # HTTP proxy mode
  mcp-cross --http https://api.example.com/mcp
  mcp-cross --http https://api.example.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

  # HTTP proxy via WSL (for WSL-stored tokens)
  mcp-cross --wsl --http https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"

  # Via npx with delimiter
  npx mcp-cross -- node server.js
  npx mcp-cross --wsl -- node /home/user/server.js

Environment variables:
  MCP_CROSS_DEBUG=true    Enable debug logging
